newsitem.title: UK: Energy to co-develop Taiwan power project.
newsitem.headline: Energy to co-develop Taiwan power project.

text.p: Britain's Energy Group said on Wednesday it would jointly develop a coal fired 550 MW power station in Taiwan along with Full Power Corporation and China Development Corp.
Energy said the estimated cost of the project was $530 million.
The project, expected to be commissioned in 2001, is the first independent power project in Taiwan involving a major western energy group.
The project will be at Hualien on the north east coast of Taiwan.
Full Power and China Development will have 70 percent of the project rights, while the Energy Group has 30 percent and full operational and maintenance responsibility.
The coal will be sourced from outside Taiwan including from the Peabody mines in Australia, owned by Energy Group.
